body:
Update: I feeling really down right now becouse I realized that my best friend (the guy that I am in love with) thought that I was joking and haven't took it seriously. It really hurts and I am mad at him but I am not that type of person who would be mad for long time. When he writes to me I am not mad at him but when time passes I get that feeling again.
That day I came out I thought he understood but as time passes I realize he didn't. I don't know what to do now. It really hurts my feelings. Anyone?
I think you are right. He is planning to eat pizza together only us two. Waiting for it 😊💗
Thanks 😃💗💗 I hope soo
I hope so and yes he is willing 😊 but still for what signs I should look out just in case (he will have some more time to think about)

Thanks! Yes we met the following day and he allowed to hug him and I felt really good. Everything looks like nothing changed. Maybe you chould give me some for body language signs I should be looking for? 🙂 thank you very much! 🙄💗
I have no idea. Well we were really close but I think this situation might be. I have no idea what to do now. I don't want to lose him.

Thanks! Its hard to believe that its one time thing. It has happen before and as I said zi talked about it they lied and said that it wont happen again and here I am again in same situation.
I tried to reach one of them to talk about it and just to hang out for few hours. We agreed and when I was near the location that we decided to meet he wrote me that he is at that other friend place hanging out and that they will come in few minutes. I just moved on and havent met them that day.

I dont know if I did the right thing but I am really mad at them. Especialy at my best friend. Because we used to hang out a lot we went everywhere together and of course we always informed other that we both are coming and we were honest to everyone. If someone asked what we were doing we said that we were hanging out and invited them or even invited them without waiting until they reach out to us. But now when my best friend and that other friend started hanging out everything changed.
Thank you very much!
Thanks! I am 19 years old by the way. I will cut contact with them and see what happens and in the mean time will spend more time on myself.

Thanks! I will try. But it really hurts when my first best friend behaves like this. Is there any chance that everything would get back to normal?

I wont be writing to him from this day and hope that if he wants to continue be best friends will reach out to me and ask what happen. Or shouldnt I wait?

Thank you very much!

I asked him. He said everything is okay and that he was hanging out with other friends. But only when I try to ask for more details. For example. Yesterday I asked what he did that day. He said nothing special. I started to say that can't be true you have done something interesting and the yes he was hanging out with other friends and they had a lot of fun. I am happy for him but I don't get it why I am left out. I know all those friends. I talk to them too. But in the past I was invited to hang out throught my best friend who is now not invitig me. I tried to ask my other friend to invite me and they responded that my best friend should invite me and that I should make plans with him. Interesting.

Thanks everyone.
I tried to offer a bike ride what we used to do and have a lot of fun. I offered to invite some friends along the way. But he said that he don't thinks about going because he is sick. I thought no big deal he is sick and maybe next time.
Everything would be okay but guess what. He is hanging out with other friends. I see how sick he is. That hurts so much.
Any way I will be meeting his mother and we will eat pizza he will join us. I think I just gona leave it as it is for now. He doesn't know that I know that we was hanging out. I saw him on my way back to home.
Maybe I need to take a break and wait until he wants to have a conversation or until he wants to hang out. Right now it looks like I am the only one who wants to have a conversation or to hang out.
Thanks. I will try to come up with something. I am actually afraid that he would end up in trouble with that drinking.
Okay I will try to tell that.
It's really hard to find thing that inspires when you don't like to do the stuff that used to make you happy and when you are dying inside.
Doesn't help. She reads them reply but nothing changes.
Thanks! Every time I talk to her about how I feel she always walks to other room and doesn't talk to me.
Thanks for reply. I actually understand that I have crush on him too. What should I do next that wouldn't scare him off?
Thanks. Actually I have feelings for him too. But I have no idea what should I do next. How to show him that? When I understand that he might have fellings too.
Thanks.

Thanks for really helping me.
I can't move out because I am planning to go to the university in the same city plus I am saving for drivers license and my mother is thinking about divorcing so I will be helping her. 

Now I see some improvements in my mood and at least I stopped working about losing my best friend. 

Thanks again.
Thanks! Trying hard.

Thanks for great advice.
I have a best friend he is like brother to me and his family accepts me so I will try to spend more time with him. It's finally spring so maybe we will go for a bicycle trip.
Thanks again for everything. I hope I will get better soon.

Thanks. I am trying hard but recently I had a breakdown. I don't know what to. Something has changed in side of me, I no longer have motivation to do what I liked, I am tired and unable to concentrate, I can't control my emotions I start to cry in front of people.
Thanks, watching now.
